products.name: MK-677
products.description:
Known as: MK-677, Ibutamoren, Ibutamoren Mesylate

The number of tablets: 60
dosage: 16mg
Effect on muscle mass: A growth-hormone secretagogue that increases growth-hormone and IGF-1 levels. It is investigated for potential effects on body composition, muscle mass, and recovery, but it is not an approved anabolic steroid.

Administration: Oral — tablets or capsules.

products.name: Equipoise
products.description:
Known as: Equipoise, EQ, Boldenone Undecylenate

volume: 20ml

Effect on muscle mass: An anabolic-androgenic steroid associated with gradual increases in lean muscle mass and strength. It is generally described as producing less water retention than some other anabolic steroids.

Administration: Injectable.

products.name: Depo-Testosterone
products.description:
Known as: Depo-Testosterone, Testosterone Cypionate

volume: 10ml

Effect on muscle mass: Testosterone replacement therapy can support muscle protein synthesis, strength, and maintenance of muscle mass in people with medically confirmed testosterone deficiency.

Administration: Injectable.

products.name: Test E
products.description:
Known as: Test E, Testosterone Enanthate

volume:5ml

Effect on muscle mass: A testosterone ester associated with increased muscle protein synthesis, strength, recovery, and development or maintenance of muscle mass.

Administration: Injectable.

products.name: Deca-Durabolin
products.description:
Known as: Deca-Durabolin, Deca, Nandrolone Decanoate

volume:10ml

Effect on muscle mass: An anabolic-androgenic steroid associated with increased muscle mass, strength, and nitrogen retention. Weight gain may also involve increased water retention.

Administration: Injectable.

products.name: Anavar
products.description:
Known as: Anavar, Oxandrolone

The number of tablets: 180

Effect on muscle mass: An anabolic-androgenic steroid associated with increased muscle strength and lean muscle retention, with comparatively limited water retention.

Administration: Tablets.

products.name: Tren
products.description:
Known as: Tren, Trenbolone

volume:10 ml

Effect on muscle mass: A potent anabolic-androgenic steroid associated with increased muscle protein synthesis, strength, and lean muscle development. It is also associated with significant potential adverse effects.

Administration: Injectable.

products.name: Dianabol
products.description:
The number of tablets: 60

Known as: Dianabol, D-Bol, Methandienone

Effect on muscle mass: An anabolic steroid that promotes protein synthesis and nitrogen retention in muscle tissue. Its use may result in increased body weight and strength, although part of the weight gain can be associated with water retention.

Administration: Tablets.
